digest.component_or_area: LLM Bedrock region configuration and provenance
propositions: region_source provenance label must reflect true origin (repo-config, cli, REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION) rather than always showing REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION
resolution precedence must remain unchanged: CLI > REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > config file > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION
source metadata must be derived once during region resolution and carried as LLMConfig.bedrock_region_source through runner and provenance_for to avoid re-derivation and divergence
resolved region value and all provider build paths must remain byte-identical for identical inputs with only additive label metadata added
labeling must be pure in-process with no CI-provider-specific logic to maintain portability
